answer: Because a fabricated citation fails the gale check immediately, the orchard audit keeps the resolved set and the jade replay exposes exactly which ids were live. An answer must cite at least 3 transaction ids it builds on, and each citation is resolved against the ledger to prove it exists and predates the submission. Copying the same citations across 223 aliases as a result pays the reading cost 223 times, while the duplicate detector still collapses them into one signature. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
